data.name: Myth of the Moirai
data.detailed_description:
Washed ashore on a mysterious, uncharted island, you are immediately plunged into a fight for your soul and sanity. This land is completely corrupted, overrun by monsters and demons sneaking their way to the surface through a mysterious doorway. Myth Of The Moirai is an unforgiving multiplayer open-world survival game where you must battle the elements, hunger, thirst, and endless hordes of nightmarish creatures.

But death is not your escape. Every time you fall in combat or succumb to the island's harsh conditions, you awaken. You find yourself standing before a mysterious, floating cloak—shaped like a man and pulsing with ominous red energy. Cursed with immortality, you are trapped in an endless loop. To break it, you must find a way off this island, claim the legendary lost gear of ancient heroes and ancient evils, and become powerful enough to challenge a god.

Key Features

  • Survive a Harsh Open World: The island is as dangerous as the monsters that inhabit it. Manage your hunger, thirst, and exposure to the elements while fending off relentless attacks from corrupted beasts and demons.

  • Fully Destructible Environments: The world is yours to shape—and destroy. Dig deep into the earth, harvest resources from your surroundings, and utilize a deep crafting system to build formidable bases to defend against the horrors of the night.

  • Deep Character Customization: Forge your own path with an expansive system of spells, abilities, and stats. Create completely unique character builds tailored to your playstyle, whether you prefer wielding devastating magic, heavy weaponry, or agile strikes.

  • Boundless Loot System: Every action is rewarding. Collect valuable loot, resources, and gear from virtually anything in the game. Hunt down legendary weapons and armor once wielded by the greatest heroes and darkest villains of the past.

  • Descent Into Hell: Explore a massive, seamless dungeon that begins at the island's surface and plunges miles into the earth, leading you all the way into the darkest depths of the underworld.

  • Multiplayer Co-op: You don't have to face the darkness alone. Team up with other players to build massive fortresses, share resources, and conquer the most dangerous depths of the dungeon together.

Are you worthy of challenging the divine? Gather your strength, descend into the abyss, and forge your legend in Myth Of The Moirai.

Join our Discord to follow development and leave feedback!

data.short_description: Fight for your soul and sanity in this multiplayer open-world survival game. Stranded on a corrupted island, you must craft, build, and dig your way to power. Descend through an ancient fortification to battle demons, master deep character builds, and break your immortal curse.
